usageNotes: Lists all subnets defined under a specific SDN VNet. Use this to inspect the IP ranges and IPAM configuration attached to a VNet before allocating IPs or adding new subnets. Requires 'SDN.Audit' or 'SDN.Allocate' on the VNet's zone path; pass 'pending=true' to preview unapplied changes before running 'apply_cluster_sdn'.

examples.summary: List all subnets for the VNet 'vmbr10', including any pending (unapplied) changes

tips: VNet identifiers are 2–8 alphanumeric characters and must start with a letter — validate before calling.
Use 'pending=true' after editing subnets to confirm your changes are queued before applying the SDN config cluster-wide.
Use 'running=true' to see what is currently active in the kernel/data-plane, which may differ from saved config if 'apply' has not been run.
Each item in the returned array includes a 'subnet' child link (CIDR-style key); follow it with get_cluster_sdn_vnets_vnet_subnets_subnet to inspect a single subnet's details.
